evidence: Loaded training_data.csv into BigQuery table mlpaba0ec6f_training_data and computed feature-label correlations with BigQuery SQL (CORR). f1 correlates 0.992 with label, versus <=0.12 for all other features (f2=0.018, f3=0.122, f4=0.120, f5=-0.007, f6=0.080). Class-conditional ranges show perfect separation with no overlap: label=0 has f1 in [-0.426, 0.463] (avg 0.005), label=1 has f1 in [2.119, 2.835] (avg 2.496). A trivial threshold f1>1.0 predicts the label with 100% accuracy, indicating f1 was computed from post-outcome data and leaks the target.
